Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the preparation of an impact plan on the state route number 520 bridge replacement and HOV project.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an impact plan on the state route number 520bridge replacement and HOV project; and adding a new section to chapter47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The city of Seattle shall prepare a plan for addressing theimpacts of the state route number 520 bridge replacement and HOVproject on Seattle neighborhoods, parks, and institutions of highereducation. In evaluating the project's impacts, the city shall givegreat weight to the concerns of neighborhoods and institutions ofhigher education impacted by design proposals. (2) The legislature intends that the plan will allow acomprehensive approach to mitigating the impacts of the project andthat the city presents the plan to the department. (3) The mayor of Seattle and the Seattle city council shall convenean advisory committee to help finalize the plan; however, the mayor ofSeattle and the Seattle city council have final approval of the plan.The city must designate representation from the community council of p. 1 SB 6651each neighborhood impacted by the state route number 520 bridgereplacement and HOV project and representation from the Washington parkarboretum to serve on the advisory committee to guide the planningprocess and for plan preparation. The University of Washington andsecretary of transportation shall each designate a representative toserve on the advisory committee. (4) The department shall not commence construction on any part ofthe state route number 520 bridge replacement and HOV project untilagreements have been reached with the city that are consistent with theplan.
